targets.query:
import "join"
import "dict"
import "array"

unitMap = [
    "Печь 1": "digitalegiz:Baker1_001989_ESP32_Dala_Meter",
    "Печь 2": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_001994",
    "Печь 3": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_006906",
    "Печь 4": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_007085",
    "Печь 5": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_007108",
    "Миксер 3": "digitalegiz:ESP32",
    "Миксер 2": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_001990",
    "Миксер 1": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002006",
    "Шкаф 1": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002004",
    "Шкаф 2": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002008",
    "Шкаф 3": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_006411",
    "Формовщик 1": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002003",
    "Формовщик 2": "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002005",
]

mappedIds = [
    "digitalegiz:Baker1_001989_ESP32_Dala_Meter",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_001994",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_006906",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_007085",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_007108",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_001990",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002006",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002004",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002008",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_006411",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002003",
    "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002005",
]

meterCols = ["thingId", "value_current_a", "value_current_a_a", "value_current_b_a", "value_current_c_a", "value_voltage_v", "value_power_w"]

metersAll = from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -60s)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "value_active_power_w" then "value_power_w" else r._field }))
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: meterCols)
  |> limit(n: 1)

machinesReal = metersAll
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.thingId, set: mappedIds))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with priority: 1.0 }))
  |> group()

skeleton = array.from(rows: [
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:Baker1_001989_ESP32_Dala_Meter", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_001994", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_006906", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_007085", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_007108", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_001990", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002006", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002004", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002008", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_006411", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002003", priority: 0.0},
    {thingId: "digitalegiz:ESP32_Dala_Meter_002005", priority: 0.0},
])

machineMeters = union(tables: [machinesReal, skeleton])
  |> group(columns: ["thingId"])
  |> sort(columns: ["priority"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: meterCols)

ordersRaw = from(bucket: "qms")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  // Источник - переменная mode, как ?demo= на доске: work - только завод,
  // demo - только демо-поток, all - оба. Демо лежит рядом, в
  // qms_batch_event_demo, и настоящую историю не трогает.
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      ("${mode}" != "demo" and r._measurement == "qms_batch_event") or
      ("${mode}" != "work" and r._measurement == "qms_batch_event_demo"))
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.order)
  |> group(columns: ["order"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.unit)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with thingId: dict.get(dict: unitMap, key: r.unit, default: "") }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId != "")
  |> group(columns: ["thingId"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
      order: if exists r.order then "№ " + r.order else "—",
      product: if exists r.product_name then r.product_name else "—",
      quantity: if exists r.quantity then string(v: int(v: r.quantity)) + " шт" else "—",
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["thingId", "order", "product", "quantity"])
  |> group()

currentOrders = union(tables: [ordersRaw, array.from(rows: [
    {thingId: "__sentinel__", order: "—", product: "—", quantity: "—"}])])

machines = join.full(left: machineMeters, right: currentOrders,
    on: (l, r) => l.thingId == r.thingId,
    as: (l, r) => ({ l with
        thingId: if exists l.thingId then l.thingId else r.thingId,
        order: if exists r.order then r.order else "—",
        product: if exists r.product then r.product else "—",
        quantity: if exists r.quantity then r.quantity else "—",
    }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId != "__sentinel__")

machines |> yield(name: "machines")

metersAll
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r.thingId, set: mappedIds))
  |> group()
  |> yield(name: "meters_only")

panels.description: Общее потребление всех устройств за сегодня

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Active_energy_positive_kwh" or r["_field"] == "value_total_energy_kwh")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: spread, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Общий расход за сегодня

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Power_factor_total" or r["_field"] == "value_power_factor" or r["_field"] == "value_power_factor_total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
